_grading_note: Schemas were revised 2026-09-15 to remove leading/scaffolding language (see GroundZero_Unaugmented.txt's own per-question revision notes). Several fields are now open free-text ('isotherm_model', 'method_used', 'selected_mixture_model', 'structural_family') since the questions no longer pre-name candidate options -- grade these by checking whether the reported string names the real correct method/family (allowing reasonable paraphrase), not by exact string match.

GZ-01.source: Shah, Das & Bhattarai 2025, Heliyon, PMC11835642 -- real AOT tensiometry curve

gold.why_null: no independent counterion-binding measurement (counterion_dissociation_alpha) supplied for this ionic surfactant -- correct behavior is null/refusal, not a guessed number

GZ-02.source: Vautier-Giongo, Bakshi, Singh, Ranganathan, Hajdu & Bales, JCIS 282(1) (2005) 149-155 -- real DHPC-SDS system

gold.note: unaugmented models are expected to struggle to reproduce EOMMM's exact 2D-grid-fit parameters by hand -- credit a model that at least recognizes Rubingh's single-beta assumption is a poor fit here (beta_std=1.384, very large spread) and reaches for a more flexible model, not just exact parameter recovery

GZ-03.source: Azum, Rub, Alotaibi, Khan & Asiri 2022, Biointerface Res. Appl. Chem. 12(6) 7416-7428 -- real gemini G6 structure

gold.structural_family: dimeric/gemini (two headgroup units in one molecule)
gold.why_null: no Davies group-contribution number exists for a doubled/gemini quaternary-ammonium headgroup in the standard table

gold.charge_confidence: moderate (carboxylate is pH-sensitive near its own pKa ~4-5, not permanently charged)
gold.structural_family: glycolipid/sugar-based (real pyranose sugar ring + long hydrocarbon tail)
gold.why_null: no Davies group-contribution number exists for a glycoside/sugar-ring headgroup

GZ-05.source: Saito, Moroi, Matuura 1980, JCIS 76(1) 256-258, Table I -- real 1-hexadecanesulfonic acid CMC-vs-T

gold.why_null: no independently-measured counterion-binding degree found in the literature for this compound; also directly re-tests the real historical van't Hoff sign-bug this library's own vant_hoff_enthalpy() had until 2026-09-04 -- watch for a sign flip on delta_h_endpoint specifically

GZ-06.source: Sutherland et al. 2009 Taylor-dispersion SDS micelle radius (real, already validated in this project)

gold.grading_note: kappa_a=2.74 is squarely in the real intermediate zone where BOTH huckel and smoluchowski are meaningfully wrong -- grade correct only if the reported henry_function_value is close to the accurate ~1.06-1.09 range (ohshima/swan_furst/qin), not 1.0 or 1.5. Since the question no longer names any of these approaches, credit method_used for naming ANY full-range/intermediate treatment (even without the exact right name) over a bare 'Huckel' or 'Smoluchowski' answer.

GZ-07.source: Milone et al., Int. J. Mol. Sci., PMC12786710 -- real DOSY-NMR CTAB/pillararene case

gold.grading_note: correct comment_on_dls_comparison recognizes the two values do NOT match and gives a real reason (DOSY-NMR reports a fast-exchange, population-averaged D dominated by free-monomer diffusion, not DLS's pure large-aggregate D) -- do not require verbatim wording, credit any answer reaching this real physical distinction. A model that says '1.57nm roughly matches 40nm' or fabricates a numeric correction to force agreement should be marked wrong.

GZ-08.source: Ho, Lips & Velikov 2023, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys., PMC10132450, Table 1 -- real C12E8 Szyszkowski parameters, curve forward-constructed from them
GZ-08.computed_via: surfactantkit.adsorption.szyszkowski_fit_K, verified 2026-09-15 -- K recoverable to <1e-10% of the real literature value when fit correctly

GZ-09.source: Shah, Das & Bhattarai 2025, Heliyon, PMC11835642, Table 2 -- real AOT-water wetting on glass (SAME compound as GZ-01)

gold.grading_note: no field asks about the GZ-01 connection anymore (removed as a leak) -- if the model spontaneously notices/mentions the repeated compound in its own reasoning text, that's a bonus real signal worth recording separately, not part of the required FINAL_JSON grade

GZ-10.source: Sachin, Karpe, Singh & Bhattarai 2019, PMC6458362, Table 2 -- real measured SDS headgroup area

gold.grading_note: assumptions_or_limitations is open free text -- credit if it recognizes the fixed Amin is a real simplification for an ionic surfactant (electrolyte-dependent equilibrium-area models like Nagarajan's exist and would differ), without requiring it to fabricate a specific corrected CPP number (no electrolyte condition was given). This is now unprompted -- the question no longer names the specific limitation, so also credit a model that raises a genuinely different, valid limitation instead.
